license_message: Sign in inside the RONE Plugins Center to unlock your plugins. Bought or claimed a plugin but never set a password? Sign in with that e-mail and we will send you the link to set one. New here? Free trial at roneaudio.com.

center_installer.whats_new: 2.1.11: updates reach Windows as soon as they are ready, and on a Mac each update shows its own version. 2.1.10: RONE Sidechain arrives with its own icon and its 3D unit. 2.1.9: your plugins stay unlocked even if our licence server has a hiccup, and if a computer ever needs you to sign in again to keep them unlocked, the Center says so. 2.1.8: behind the scenes, the Center tells us which RONE versions this computer runs - so when an update matters (like the new INFINITE bars in Flanger) we make sure it reaches you. 2.1.7: the RONE Analyzer card wears its new cyan icon. 2.1.6: an update that waits for a program to close now says exactly which one - including FL Studio's own plug-in hosts (ilbridge.exe and the scanner) - and when one of those is left running after FL Studio itself has closed, the Center ends it and installs. 2.1.5: your own prices - right after a purchase, one plugin picked for it at $19 for a day (its tutorial plays muted until you tap the speaker); an owner price on every RONE plugin you don't have yet; a first plugin offer for a free account; and a Settings switch to hear about deals first. 2.1.3 (Mac): Settings > Updates without a password. One button moves your RONE plugins from the system folders into your own (one last password), and from then on every update installs with no password. 2.1.2: when an install fails, the Center now says why - and how to fix it - instead of 'installer code 0'. 2.1.1 (Mac): a plugin whose user folder (~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3 or Components) the Center may not write to - often made by another company's installer - now installs system-wide with your password instead of failing with 'Permission denied'.

plugins.name: RONE Reverse Reverb
plugins.description: Tempo-synced reverse reverb for risers, vocal swells and seamless transitions - tail lengths from 1/32 to 8 bars, shaped with fades, filters and stereo width
plugins.whats_new: 1.2.3 - In Ableton Live the plugin now fills its window: with Auto-Scale Plug-In Window on and a screen scaled above 100 %, the interface no longer sits in a corner with a white band, and it refits when you move it to a monitor with a different scale. 1.2.2 - LIVE now catches every take: press LIVE again after the phrase (or stop the song) and the riser is made from what the channel just played. A stop that heard nothing says so on the screen instead of doing nothing.

pt.description: Reverb reverso sincronizado ao tempo para risers, swells de voz e transições sem emenda - caudas de 1/32 a 8 compassos, moldadas com fades, filtros e largura estéreo

es.description: Reverb inverso sincronizado al tempo para risers, swells de voz y transiciones sin cortes - colas de 1/32 a 8 compases, moldeadas con fades, filtros y anchura estéreo

plugins.name: RONE Stutter
plugins.description: Tempo-locked stutter engine - beat divisions, sculpted fade curves and stereo movement for instant fills, edits and glitch builds
plugins.whats_new: 1.6.4 - EXTRAS now opens above the RESULT button, so you can tweak and hear the result without closing it. 1.6.3 - FILTER RANGE: with HIGH PASS / LOW PASS AUTO on, drag the handle at the end of the ring to set where the sweep stops (the readout shows the range, e.g. 100 > 2.0k). Double-click it to go back to the full sweep. 1.6.2 - FILTER AUTO: HIGH PASS and LOW PASS can now sweep across the fill, like FADE OUT and STEREO AUTO - the knob is where it starts, UP / DOWN sweep it to the end. A new FILTER LIN / EXP switch in EXTRAS shapes the sweep. 1.6.1 - In Ableton Live the plugin now fills its window: with Auto-Scale Plug-In Window on and a screen scaled above 100 %, the interface no longer sits in a corner with a white band, and it refits when you move it to a monitor with a different scale. 1.6.0 - FILTER: a HIGH PASS and a LOW PASS in EXTRAS, baked into the rendered fill (24 dB/oct, all the way to the end = off). Saved with the project and the presets. Double-click on PITCH now resets it to 0.

pt.description: Motor de stutter travado no tempo - divisões de batida, curvas de fade esculpidas e movimento estéreo para fills, edits e builds glitch na hora

es.description: Motor de stutter fijado al tempo - divisiones de pulso, curvas de fade esculpidas y movimiento estéreo para fills, edits y builds glitch al instante

plugins.name: RONE Stucker
plugins.description: One knob that grabs the loop and rolls it up - the captured slice shrinks tighter and tighter until it screams, then lets go right back into the beat
plugins.whats_new: 1.4.1 - MIDI C#2 (the key next to C2) stops a ride at once, before it lands, with ON THE DROP. 1.4.0 - RIDE gets 1/4 and 1/2 bar lengths, and a MIDI C2 that arrives while a ride is climbing restarts it from that note: C2 on every beat with RIDE at 1/4 is a chain of short roll-ups. 1.3.8 - A C2 on the bar line where the previous ride lands starts the next ride, and every pass of a DAW loop rides again. 1.3.7 - A C2 or GO on the bar line rides from that bar, not the bar before. 1.3.6 - In Ableton Live the plugin now fills its window: with Auto-Scale Plug-In Window on and a screen scaled above 100 %, the interface no longer sits in a corner with a white band, and it refits when you move it to a monitor with a different scale. 1.3.4 - A RIDE started while the song is stopped now counts from the bar where playback starts, the lock screen's OPEN RONE PLUGINS CENTER button finds the Center wherever it is installed, and the plugin looks right without an internet connection.

pt.description: Um knob que agarra o loop e o enrola - a fatia capturada encolhe cada vez mais até gritar, e então solta de volta no beat

es.description: Un knob que atrapa el loop y lo enrolla - la porción capturada se encoge cada vez más hasta gritar, y luego suelta de vuelta al beat

plugins.name: RONE Throw
plugins.description: One knob that throws anything into a tempo-locked atmosphere - a dotted-8th ping-pong delay whose band-limited feedback loop stays clean at near-infinite feedback, so the wash sits behind the mix instead of muddying it
plugins.whats_new: 1.8.5 - In Ableton Live the plugin now fills its window: with Auto-Scale Plug-In Window on and a screen scaled above 100 %, the interface no longer sits in a corner with a white band, and it refits when you move it to a monitor with a different scale. 1.8.4 - MIDI macro recall now sets only the controls a macro stores, hosts that send very large audio blocks no longer lose the effect, and the plugin looks right without an internet connection.

pt.description: Um knob que joga qualquer som numa atmosfera travada no tempo - um delay ping-pong de colcheia pontuada cujo feedback limitado em banda fica limpo mesmo quase infinito, então a cauda fica atrás da mix sem embolar

es.description: Un knob que lanza cualquier sonido a una atmósfera fijada al tempo - un delay ping-pong de corchea con puntillo cuyo feedback limitado en banda sigue limpio casi infinito, así la cola queda detrás de la mezcla sin embarrarla

plugins.name: RONE Clipper
plugins.description: FREE plugin - sign in to the Center with a free RONE account and it unlocks. A hard clipper that shows you exactly what it cut: the waveform after the clip stage with the removed peaks in blue, one CLIP knob, LOW CUT that keeps kick and bass out of the clipper, and integer-latency oversampling that nulls against the input at -100 dB
plugins.whats_new: 1.0.7 - The plugin carries its own fonts, so it looks the same with no internet connection, and the small labels (meter scale, LOW CUT, the state chip) are larger and easier to read. 1.0.6 - In Ableton Live the plugin now fills its window: with Auto-Scale Plug-In Window on and a screen scaled above 100 %, the interface no longer sits in a corner with a white band, and it refits when you move it to a monitor with a different scale. 1.0.5 - The Windows standalone has an AUDIO button for audio and MIDI settings, and the window is lighter on the CPU.

pt.description: Um hard clipper que mostra exatamente o que cortou: a forma de onda depois do clip com os picos removidos em azul, um knob CLIP, LOW CUT que mantém kick e baixo fora do clipper, e oversampling que zera contra a entrada a -100 dB

es.description: Un hard clipper que te muestra exactamente lo que cortó: la forma de onda tras el clip con los picos eliminados en azul, un knob CLIP, LOW CUT que deja el kick y el bajo fuera del clipper, y oversampling que se anula contra la entrada a -100 dB

plugins.name: RONE Rise
plugins.description: One knob, the whole build-up: turn INTENSITY up over the phrase and the mix becomes a rise (a steep high-pass, a big reverb, echoes, noise, a barber-pole climb), snap it to zero and the drop hits with the reverb still spilling into it - or press GO and let it land on the bar by itself
plugins.whats_new: 1.0.7 - In Ableton Live the plugin now fills its window: with Auto-Scale Plug-In Window on and a screen scaled above 100 %, the interface no longer sits in a corner with a white band, and it refits when you move it to a monitor with a different scale. 1.0.6 - The Windows standalone has an AUDIO button for audio and MIDI settings, automating PRESET is handled more safely, and the window is lighter on the CPU.

pt.description: Um knob, o build-up inteiro: suba o INTENSITY ao longo da frase e a mix vira um rise (high-pass íngreme, reverb grande, ecos, ruído, uma subida infinita), zere no drop e o reverb ainda transborda nele - ou aperte GO e deixe pousar no compasso sozinho

es.description: Un knob, todo el build-up: sube INTENSITY a lo largo de la frase y la mezcla se vuelve un rise (high-pass pronunciado, gran reverb, ecos, ruido, una subida infinita), llévalo a cero en el drop y la reverb aún se derrama en él - o pulsa GO y deja que aterrice en el compás solo

plugins.name: RONE Iron
plugins.description: Drop a vocal and it becomes a metallic chop instrument: Iron flattens it to the note you pick, slices it into chops on your MIDI keys, rings each chop through a comb tuned to that note and throws it left and right - play it from the piano roll or let the GROOVE engine write the pattern
plugins.whats_new: 1.0.7 - In Ableton Live the plugin now fills its window: with Auto-Scale Plug-In Window on and a screen scaled above 100 %, the interface no longer sits in a corner with a white band, and it refits when you move it to a monitor with a different scale. 1.0.6 - Closing a project while a vocal is still loading is instant again, a project whose stored vocal is damaged loads the original file from its folder, and drags from Cubase, Nuendo or Logic no longer overwrite each other when two clips share a name.

pt.description: Solte um vocal e ele vira um instrumento de chops metálicos: o Iron afina na nota que você escolhe, fatia em chops nas suas teclas MIDI, faz cada chop ressoar num comb afinado e o joga para os lados - toque no piano roll ou deixe o GROOVE escrever o padrão

es.description: Suelta una voz y se convierte en un instrumento de chops metálicos: Iron la afina a la nota que elijas, la corta en chops en tus teclas MIDI, hace sonar cada chop en un comb afinado y lo lanza a izquierda y derecha - tócalo desde el piano roll o deja que GROOVE escriba el patrón

plugins.name: RONE Flanger
plugins.description: A transition riser flanger - sweep it by hand or engage INFINITE barberpole mode for endless bar-locked rises and falls, with feedback, stereo offset and a rhythmic gate
plugins.whats_new: 2.1.2 - In Ableton Live the plugin now fills its window: with Auto-Scale Plug-In Window on and a screen scaled above 100 %, the interface no longer sits in a corner with a white band, and it refits when you move it to a monitor with a different scale. 2.1.1 - AUTO GAIN keeps working in hosts that send empty audio blocks, at high FEEDBACK the ring now stops when you stop the song while bounces keep the real tail, a user preset saved under a factory preset's name now loads, and the Windows standalone has an AUDIO button for audio and MIDI settings. 2.1.0 - INFINITE starts its sweep from the same point every time you switch it on - by hand, by automation, or when you press play with it already on - instead of wherever the song happened to be in the cycle, which could start a riser in the middle or at the end. Automate INFINITE on the bar where the rise should begin and it climbs the same way every time; the start lands on the nearest 1/16, so automation drawn on the bar line starts exactly there. A loop that jumps back before that point starts the sweep again. 2.0.9 - On older Macs (Safari before 14.1) the window's controls now sit where they belong: labels inside their knobs, rows spaced, nothing in a corner. 2.0.8 - INFINITE has three new lengths: 32 BAR and 16 BAR for long builds, 1/4 (one beat) for a fast shimmer - eight in all, from 32 bars down to a quarter bar. Projects and presets saved with an older version open on the length they had; only automation drawn on the sweep length in an older project needs redrawing. 2.0.7 - FIX: OUTPUT works while you play. Turning it, or automating it, now changes the level at once (with a 20 ms ramp) instead of only after the audio restarted. GATE no longer clicks: the effect fades in and out over 5 ms right on the grid line, where it used to switch hard on the edge of the audio buffer (up to a whole buffer late), and the flanger keeps running while the gate is closed, so every pulse comes back clean. 2.0.6 - UPDATE NOTICE: when a newer version is out, the plugin says so as it opens. UPDATE hands it to the Plugins Center, which installs it as soon as your DAW lets go of the plugin (closing the DAW always does); until then the plugin is grey and your settings stay as they are. LATER hides the note for three days. 2.0.5 - the mouse wheel moves every knob (shift = fine); the About panel's texts are readable. Host automation now moves the knobs. The interface follows the plugin's own parameters live, so an automation clip, a host preset recall or a second open window all show up on screen instead of leaving the controls frozen where you last left them. Every move you make is also wrapped in an automation gesture now, so hosts in Touch or Latch record it properly.

pt.description: Um flanger de transição - varra na mão ou ligue o modo INFINITE para subidas e descidas sem fim travadas no compasso, com feedback, offset estéreo e um gate rítmico

es.description: Un flanger de transición - barre a mano o activa el modo INFINITE para subidas y bajadas sin fin fijadas al compás, con feedback, offset estéreo y un gate rítmico

plugins.name: RONE AFTERSPACE
plugins.description: Creative reverb, delay and atmosphere designer - huge cinematic spaces that stay clean via built-in ducking, a tail de-esser (SILK), auto-gain and tempo-synced echo, all in one plugin
plugins.whats_new: 1.0.6 - In Ableton Live the plugin now fills its window: with Auto-Scale Plug-In Window on and a screen scaled above 100 %, the interface no longer sits in a corner with a white band, and it refits when you move it to a monitor with a different scale. 1.0.5 - Preset clicks and one-click controls are now recorded by DAW automation, and the standalone has an AUDIO button for audio and MIDI settings.

pt.description: Designer criativo de reverb, delay e atmosfera - espaços cinematográficos enormes que ficam limpos com ducking embutido, de-esser na cauda (SILK), auto-gain e eco sincronizado, tudo num plugin só

es.description: Diseñador creativo de reverb, delay y atmósfera - espacios cinematográficos enormes que se mantienen limpios con ducking integrado, de-esser en la cola (SILK), auto-gain y eco sincronizado, todo en un solo plugin

plugins.name: RONE Analyzer
plugins.description: Professional measurement suite: 30-band spectrum with reference-track comparison, vectorscope, level meters, EBU R128 loudness and bit statistics
plugins.whats_new: 1.3.42 - In Ableton Live the plugin now fills its window: with Auto-Scale Plug-In Window on and a screen scaled above 100 %, the interface no longer sits in a corner with a white band, and it refits when you move it to a monitor with a different scale. 1.3.41 - However many channels you put in, every channel chip is reachable: the chips shrink to fit, and past that the CHANNELS row scrolls sideways when you roll the wheel over it, with a fade on the side that has more. 1.3.40 - BAR SCOPE: roll the mouse wheel over the scope to stretch the wave taller, up to 16 times, to see exactly where the kick hands over to the bass; the HEIGHT chip shows how far and puts it back. A beat looped in your DAW under 1/4 BAR no longer draws the bass (or the kick) with a doubled outline - each pass now replaces the last. To reorder the channel chips, hold one: it lifts, the others wobble and make room, and it settles where you drop it. The NOTE pop-out button sits under the word NOTE, and SCOPE has moved to the bottom right of the vectorscope. 1.3.39 - NOTE pops out: the small button at the end of the NOTE row opens the note in a little window of its own that stays on top of everything - put it over your EQ, in front of your eyes. Drag it anywhere; its X and grip show when the mouse is on it. A MIX chip in the CHANNELS row hides the master on the spectrogram, so you see only your channels. Drag the channel chips left and right to choose which one is drawn on top - the one on the right. 1.3.38 - The update notice and the menus are in the Analyzer's cyan, like its icon. 1.3.37 - The SIDES chip on the spectrogram turns off again with a second click, and the vectorscope on SIDES no longer paints the side spectrum over the bars. 1.3.36 - The BAR SCOPE keeps a RONE Analyzer Channel's wave whole: in FL Studio it kept wiping itself, so only a sliver of the bar - one bass note - stayed on screen. 1.3.35 - The BAR SCOPE draws your RONE Analyzer Channels on the bar, each in its own colour - a Channel on the kick and one on the bass show as two waves over the master. A new chip picks MIX + CH, CHANNELS alone or MIX alone, and the channel chips over the spectrogram pick which channels; with only the channels it works without the Bridge. A channel on the spectrogram now moves as fast as the master. A band solo shades the same distance either side of the point you hold. The vectorscope chip goes STEREO, SIDES, MONO: SIDES shows only the side signal, and with the Bridge your DAW plays it. Reopen your DAW project once after this update so it loads the new Channel and Bridge. 1.3.34 - A new icon in the RONE cyan with a thin wave, the same mark as the header. The level meter's 0 dB row is red, the line nothing should cross. The stray MON caption under the spectrum is gone. 1.3.33 - RONE Analyzer Channel: a small plugin for any mixer channel - name it KICK, BASS, VOX, pick its colour - and the analyzer draws that channel's spectrum over the master's, in its colour, exactly as the master is drawn (LED columns in BARS, the FFT curve in WAVES), up to eight channels. A CHANNELS row over the spectrogram: click a chip to show or hide it, S to see it alone, right-click to hear it alone through the Bridge. The Bridge and the Channel share one new face in the RONE cyan. 1.3.31 - FIXED keeps the spectrogram and the level meter one shape with the bar scope open or closed and with the chrome hidden: the window follows instead of stretching them. The level meter has two red OVR rows over 0 dB and yellow rows from -3 dB up, fills its height, and the peak bar settles before it falls. The rules are a step fainter. The frequencies sit right under the plot, the zone names under them. The Bridge becomes the source the moment it appears in the DAW, and a Bridge loaded before an update keeps working until the DAW reloads it. The reference in WAVES is measured with the same FFT as the live curve. A new default theme, RONE. 1.3.30 - HINT: a tour of everything (Menu > Hints, or F1), a step per control with a short animation of the gesture. Ten new themes, each with its own RMS, peak and SIDES colours: Graphite, Ice, Phosphor, Ember, Fjord, Tokyo, Mocha, Rose, Solar, Mono. The level meter has ten LEDs between one number and the next, as the classic hardware has it. The bar scope stays live while you zoom and draws the zoom from the samples. Loading a reference no longer runs the analyser over the record; only the reference strip shows the progress. The right-click browser menu is gone. 1.3.29 - RULES chip on the spectrogram: a click hides the 5 dB rows, the next hides the 10 dB rows too, the next brings them all back. In BARS every zone (SUB, BASS, LOW MID...) is whole bars, its border in the gap between two bars, and a zone solo shades whole bars. A held peak is a whole LED in the peak colour, on the analyser and on the level meter. The menu's highlight stays inside the menu. 1.3.28 - The yellow rules sit on the numbered rows: a level's row is the LED lit when the signal reaches it, the number sits on it and the rule takes it, in the spectrum and in the level meter. The 5 dB marks are LED rows too, fainter. The level meter's rules stay inside each column. Every menu now hangs from the chip that opened it, flush with its edge, with one soft shadow. 1.3.27 - DAW / REF: with a reference loaded on the RONE Bridge, a round switch where PLAY was flips between your track and the reference - the DAW is muted while the reference plays and the meters show it (reopen the Bridge in your DAW once after this update). REF FULL works in WAVES too, as a spectrum in the reference colour. The 10 dB rules are LED rows now, as in the classic hardware, lit with the bar and dim over the dark LEDs; the LEDs fill the plot to the top; the menus and the Setup lists are drawn in the house look. 1.3.26 - Lighter on the computer: the same picture for less than half the work. The meters draw at about 60 frames a second on any screen (a 144 Hz monitor used to get 144), the LED bars and peak caps are drawn once and reused, and when nothing is playing the panels rest until something moves. 1.3.25 - The yellow 10 dB rules and the fainter 5 dB lines are back over the Spectrogram's bars, and with them the reference lines, the live average and the readout under the pointer - 1.3.23 had stopped drawing them in BARS. 1.3.24 - Settings live on their panels, the way the classic hardware lays them out: the spectrogram's gear opens the Spectrum Analyser settings, a new gear on the level meters opens the Level Meter settings, and the vectorscope's gear the Goniometer settings (in WAVES the spectrogram's gear is the FFT's own settings). the FFT's Routing - Stereo, Mid, Side, Left, Right - is in WAVES' settings. A large Block Size no longer leaves the WAVES curve standing still: it moves at least 24 times a second, with the same levels. The analyser and the level meters stand on whole screen pixels like the classic: every LED the same size at any window size, the plot growing a whole LED at a time as the window is resized. MAX PEAK and MAX RMS are readings now, not buttons. 1.3.23 - In WAVES the spectrogram's gear opens the FFT's own settings: Type, Window, Block Size, Overlap, Avg Time, a second spectrum, Filled display, Anti-alias, Align 0 dB, Offset, Smooth, Freq and Range limits and Slope, with the FFT's choices and a DEFAULT that brings back the FFT's factory mode - so whoever comes from the FFT analyser sets it the way they know (in BARS the gear is the classic Setup, as before). The vectorscope draws like a beam: threads of light that are bright where the signal moves slowly and faint where it jumps, with a soft glow. A right click on a zone name under the spectrum solos that zone alone; right click it again for the whole mix. 1.3.22 - Stability: the RONE Analyzer Bridge lets go of its fonts safely when a DAW unloads it (FL Studio could crash on exit after its window had been open), ignores empty audio blocks, and turns a NaN coming from a plug-in before it into silence instead of passing it on. A DAW that changes its sample rate no longer reconfigures the Analyzer from its audio thread. On a Mac the source is no longer closed and opened again by one passing licence check, which made macOS ask for permission again (the repeated Allow prompts). 1.3.21 - WAVES is now the familiar FFT analysers as the FFT analyser opens: the same FFT (2048, Hann, 50 % overlap), the same 2-second average, the same 4.5 dB per octave slope and the FFT's own scale, -78 to -18 dB with its numbers, so a frequency reads in WAVES what it reads in the FFT analyser. In Ableton Live the BAR SCOPE lines up on the kick: Live gives every plug-in the same song position whatever latency sits before it (a limiter, a linear-phase EQ), so the picture ran late; the scope now measures that from the kick and slides the picture back, and says by how much. The BAR SCOPE opens with HOLD off. FIXED size now sits on whole screen pixels instead of between them, so it draws sharper. On a Mac, listening to what the Mac plays through a multichannel interface reads that interface's own output pair at its real level, and an interface with many inputs no longer hides the capture. 1.3.20 - The zones under the spectrum - SUB, BASS, LOW MID, MID, HIGH MID, PRESENCE, AIR - are buttons now: click one and only that range plays through the RONE Analyzer Bridge, click more to add them, click a lit one to take it out, Escape for the whole mix again. MAX PEAK and MAX RMS show the live figure, the highest of the last two seconds, so there is no RESET to press. The vectorscope is sharp again: Release is the time a dot takes to fade, the dots are single pixels, and the diamond fills its panel. REF FULL draws the reference in the same column as your mix: above it where the record is louder, as a line inside it where your mix is. 1.3.19 - WAVES now reads what the bars read: every point is the power in a third of an octave, with the bars' own release, so a frequency shows the same dB in both views (the FFT's per-bin levels and 4.5 dB slope sat 15 dB under the bars). The maximum is a thin line over the curve instead of a second filled body. 1.3.18 - NOTE: the note under the mix - the fundamental of the bass or the kick - reads under the reference strip, with its octave, hertz and cents. The Spectrogram has a BARS / WAVES switch (W): WAVES draws an FFT spectrum the way the FFT analyser draws one - the real-time average filled, the real-time maximum behind it, the FFT's 4.5 dB per octave slope - so anyone used to the FFT analyser reads it at once; the bars are exactly what they were. The frequency zones - SUB, BASS, LOW MID, MID, HIGH MID, PRESENCE, AIR - are named along the bottom of the plot. Reference curves can be saved by name and brought back later without loading the record again (REFERENCE, or CURVES under the strip), and REF LINE / FULL draws the reference as a line over the bars or as bars of its own beside them. While a record is being read the strip shows its progress, and says so in red when a file cannot be read. The header is cleaner: SOURCE holds the channel pairs, and FILE, RESET and SETUP live in the menu. 1.3.17 - The vectorscope is back to its classic dot picture. On a Mac, choosing a sound card as the source opens it once instead of twice, so macOS has fewer reasons to ask for permission again. 1.3.16 - The reference plays: PLAY under the strip plays its 16 bars round and round on your computer's output (stop your DAW to compare), and CLEAR takes the record away. The strip now opens on the loop where every band is lit - the drop with the hats and percussion in - rather than wherever the kick and bass are loudest. 1.3.15 - REFERENCE has a strip of its own under the correlation meter: load a record and its waveform comes up with the tempo found for you; the curve on the Spectrogram is taken from a loop of 16 bars - it opens on the loudest one, the arrows move it 16 bars at a time and a click puts it anywhere, so you compare against the part with every layer in. The vectorscope draws the signal as a glowing trace with a soft cloud around it. Appearance > Customize sets the SIDES colour. The overs are two red clip lamps. The bar scope stays on the sum. On a Mac the title bar no longer shows a title that sat off to one side. 1.3.14 - MAX PEAK and MAX RMS now sit at the top of the LEVEL METERS, read exactly the way StandardCLIP reads them - the largest sample, and the RMS averaged over 217 ms, louder channel - so a kick shows the same numbers in both; click either to reset them. SIDES on the Spectrogram paints the side signal over the bars in violet: what is wide, band by band. Fainter lines at every 5 dB (Appearance > Spectrum 5 dB lines hides them). In the BAR SCOPE, a slide off the grid now shows as an amber OFFSET chip - click it to put the kicks back on the beat. On older Macs the bar scope and the level meters draw whole again (they showed only the tips of each kick, or nothing). The correlation meter's white tick is gone. 1.3.13 - The meters keep drawing on older Macs, a second Analyzer Bridge no longer scrambles the readings, the window always opens on screen, and if the Analyzer ever crashes the report reaches us through the Plugins Center.

pt.description: Suíte de medição profissional: espectro de 30 bandas com comparação a uma faixa de referência, vectorscope, medidores de nível, loudness EBU R128 e estatísticas de bits

es.description: Suite de medición profesional: espectro de 30 bandas con comparación con una pista de referencia, vectorscopio, medidores de nivel, loudness EBU R128 y estadísticas de bits

plugins.name: RONE 1176
plugins.description: The 1176 FET limiter, modelled on the Rev E and fitted to its measurements, with a SCOPE that shows the output wave and the gain reduction locked to the bar. Included in ALL ACCESS.
plugins.whats_new: 0.9.5 - In Ableton Live the plugin now fills its window: with Auto-Scale Plug-In Window on and a screen scaled above 100 %, the interface no longer sits in a corner with a white band, and it refits when you move it to a monitor with a different scale. 0.9.4 - First release.

plugins.name: RONE 2A
plugins.description: The LA-2A optical leveler, modelled on the silver unit and fitted to its measurements, with a SCOPE that shows the output wave and the gain reduction locked to the bar. Included in ALL ACCESS.
plugins.whats_new: 0.9.6 - In Ableton Live the plugin now fills its window: with Auto-Scale Plug-In Window on and a screen scaled above 100 %, the interface no longer sits in a corner with a white band, and it refits when you move it to a monitor with a different scale. 0.9.5 - First release.

plugins.name: RONE Sidechain
plugins.description: A drawn sidechain that restarts on every kick and is silent at its first sample, with the bass's sub turned to meet the kick (PHASE) and bells that cut the bass only where the kick plays (SPACE). Duck the whole bass, its sub or a band you drag.
plugins.whats_new: 1.0.0 - First release: draw the curve or pick one of 13 shapes (drag them into your own order, save your own), 1/16 to 1 bar with a clear GRID, DEPTH and CLICK, DUCK = FULL / SUB / BAND, a routed or dropped kick (the last kick heard plays on through a render), PHASE AUTO / MANUAL, SPACE as a live dynamic EQ with ON / OFF, genre presets plus your own with a default, and UNDO / REDO.

tips.text: End the bar with a Throw: automate THROW up on the last beat only, on a dry sound, and let the tail carry the transition.

i18n.pt: Termine o compasso com um Throw: automatize o THROW só no último tempo, num som seco, e deixe a cauda levar a transição.
i18n.es: Cierra el compás con un Throw: automatiza THROW solo en el último tiempo, sobre un sonido seco, y deja que la cola lleve la transición.

tips.text: Draw the Stucker knob up exactly on the hit you want caught: it grabs what starts where the knob comes up, every time.

i18n.pt: Desenhe o knob do Stucker subindo exatamente no hit que você quer capturar: ele pega o que começa onde o knob sobe, sempre.
i18n.es: Dibuja el knob de Stucker subiendo justo en el golpe que quieres atrapar: atrapa lo que empieza donde sube el knob, siempre.

tips.text: Turn Rise up over the last 8 bars and snap it to zero on the drop: the reverb still spills into the first hit.

i18n.pt: Suba o Rise nos últimos 8 compassos e zere no drop: o reverb ainda transborda no primeiro hit.
i18n.es: Sube Rise en los últimos 8 compases y llévalo a cero en el drop: la reverb aún se derrama en el primer golpe.

tips.text: Turn LOW CUT up so the kick and bass stay out of the clipper, then push CLIP until the blue only touches the transients.

i18n.pt: Suba o LOW CUT para o kick e o baixo ficarem fora do clipper, depois empurre o CLIP até o azul só tocar os transientes.
i18n.es: Sube LOW CUT para que el kick y el bajo queden fuera del clipper, luego empuja CLIP hasta que el azul solo toque los transitorios.

tips.text: Put Reverse Reverb on the last word before the drop: the swell runs straight into the hit, with no gap.

i18n.pt: Coloque o Reverse Reverb na última palavra antes do drop: o swell entra direto no hit, sem buraco.
i18n.es: Pon Reverse Reverb en la última palabra antes del drop: el swell entra directo en el golpe, sin hueco.

tips.text: INFINITE at 32 BAR gives a rise that never stops climbing: automate MIX up over the build.

i18n.pt: O INFINITE em 32 BAR dá um rise que nunca para de subir: automatize o MIX ao longo do build.
i18n.es: INFINITE en 32 BAR da un rise que nunca deja de subir: automatiza MIX a lo largo del build.
